Issues auto-expire (~1wk TTL) and get bot-closed as not_planned - a single expiry is NOT reliably 'unfixed housekeeping'. After 2 expiries of the same theme with no source change, RETIRE it (established across 4+ themes now: try-catch-rule-utils.ts, no-json-stringify-equality, require-invalid-date-check-before-compare/#60577, no-string-fallback-for-non-string-message/#60757 as of 09-30).

Grep tool rejects lookaround (?<!...) - use plain character-class negation instead.
